settings.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Book #20 Partypoopers Release Terms & Conditions
settings.text:
1. OVERVIEW

neOwn Book Library is pleased to announce the availability of the 20th book in the Diary of a Wimpy Kid series. This allows neOwn Subscribers to reserve and rent the new release as part of their library subscription plan.

2. OFFICIAL RELEASE & AVAILABILITY

2.1. The Diary of a Wimpy Kid Book #20 Partypooper will be officially released by the publishers on 24th October 2025.

2.2. neOwn will receive 100 copies of the book on the same day (24th October 2025).

2.3. All 100 copies will be made available exclusively for rent only as part of neOwn's library subscription. Subscribers can add it to their selection from 21st October onwards.

3. ELIGIBILITY

3.1. This book is available to all neOwn subscribers, both new and existing.

3.2. The book cannot be purchased from neOwn and is only accessible as part of an active library subscription.

3.3. Non-members must purchase the subscription to get the book.

4. BOOKING PERIOD

4.1. Subscribers may book their copy of Diary of a Wimpy Kid Book #20 starting from 21st October 2025 onwards.

4.2. To secure their copy of the book, subscribers must add the book to their selection through their neOwn app.

4.3. Subscribers must note that their copy will be reserved only upon addition to their selection on the app.

5. DISPATCH & PRIORITY ALLOCATION

5.1. Dispatch of books will commence after 24th October 2025, following the official release date.

5.2. Priority dispatch will be given to subscribers who book their copies between 21st October and 24th October 2025, on a first-come, first-served basis.

5.3. The first 100 subscribers to add the book to their selection during this period will receive guaranteed allocation from the initial stock.

6. CIRCULATION & WAITLIST

6.1. As neOwn operates as a library service, books are part of a circulation system and will be shared among subscribers.

6.2. If you are not among the first 100 subscribers to book, your request will be placed in a queue, and the book will be dispatched once it becomes available from circulation.

6.3. neOwn will make every effort to ensure that waitlisted subscribers receive their copy within 5-7 days from the date they add the book to their waitlist, subject to return schedules and circulation availability.

6.4. Actual delivery times may vary based on circulation demand and subscriber return compliance.

7. GENERAL LIBRARY TERMS

7.1. All standard neOwn library Terms of Service apply to this campaign, including but not limited to rental duration, late return policies, damage charges, and subscription obligations.

7.2. Subscribers are advised to review the complete neOwn Terms of Service available on our website for detailed information regarding library operations, membership benefits, and responsibilities.

7.3. neOwn reserves the right to modify these terms or cancel bookings in case of unforeseen circumstances, including publisher delays or stock unavailability.

8. CONTACT

For questions or clarifications regarding the book release, please contact neOwn customer support through the channels provided on our website.

By booking Diary of a Wimpy Kid Book 20, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms & Conditions as well as neOwn's standard Terms of Service.

settings.title: Kranti Gada, Founder
settings.text:
After serving as COO of Shemaroo Entertainment for 4+ years, I found myself itching to apply all those learnings to creating something new.

neOwn is built on deep consumer insights I have gained over the years as well as personal experiences which makes it very close to my heart.

It is being built keeping future generations in mind.

We are a platform where you can rent and buy sustainably, a platform which is more like your partner than your retailer.
